slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on civil registration and vital statistics (October 2016 monitoring round); Benin appears only in annex bands of civil registration component scores, and the one mention of a health information system is a regional statement that in most countries it is not linked to civil registration records. No health information system is named for Benin.
